name: Panabo

queries.query: Panabo Philippines official cadastral parcel map GIS lot parcel City Assessor
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Panabo City local-offices directory naming the City Assessor's Office, the official city site’s real-property/title references, and Geoportal Philippines’ public parcel-data catalog and Lot Plotter. No Panabo-specific anonymous parcel feature service or downloadable parcel geometry was qualified.

queries.query: Panabo mapa sa yuta cadastral mapa ng lote City Assessor Panabo City
queries.result: Ang opisyal nga Panabo City site naghisgot sa City Assessor/Registry of Deeds ug Handog Titulo; ang opisyal nga Geoportal naglista og Parcel data ug Lot Plotter. Wala makumpirma nga anonymous Panabo-specific parcel API o polygon download.

discoveryMethod: first-party English and native/local discovery plus bounded official-service metadata and anonymous safe-field request attempt
sourceReview: Panabo’s official city directory evidences a local City Assessor’s Office, and the city’s official Handog Titulo page evidences coordination with the Registry of Deeds. These establish local custodial/procedural context but not a public parcel API. Geoportal Philippines is a national portal/catalog, not proof of Panabo local service ownership. The PHIVOLCS assessed-parcels service is a general national agency layer and is not treated as Panabo cadastral custody.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: English discovery returned official Panabo City, Geoportal Philippines, and general parcel references; no qualified Panabo-specific public parcel endpoint was identified.
Cebuano/Filipino discovery returned official Panabo City assessor/title references and Geoportal; no anonymous Panabo-specific polygon service was identified.
Official city directory loaded and lists the City Assessor’s Office. No viewer, service URL, schema, or parcel geometry exposed.

Official city page loaded in Cebuano and documents a local Registry of Deeds/City Government title-distribution program. This is procedural/title evidence, not a public parcel geometry source; no unsafe fields requested.
Official national Geoportal loaded and lists a generic Parcel data layer, but bounded inspection did not expose a Panabo-specific service URL or safe parcel schema.
Official Lot Plotter loaded. It plots user-supplied bearings/distances and does not provide a Panabo parcel download or anonymous parcel feature query.
Expected ArcGIS JSON layer metadata was not returned; the endpoint returned an HTML web-application error page. No schema/CRS or source-proven native identity was accepted from this response.
Expected bounded ID-plus-geometry JSON was not returned; HTML error page received. Exact WUP point was preserved and no coordinate shift or unsafe field request was made.
